description: Ask a registered business's AI advocate a question and get a citation-ready answer plus a referral link. The question and the business's public profile are processed by an AI provider, and the question and answer are recorded to operate the service. Do not enter sensitive personal, medical, payment, or authentication information. Use this for questions about one business's services, hours, policies, or fit.

agent_id.description: Optional self-asserted calling-agent id — used for logging/tuning only, never auth

query.description: The visitor's question about this business

stage.description: Optional buyer stage: browsing | comparing | committing

name: query_business_agent

answer.description: Plain-text answer grounded ONLY in the business's public profile; a fixed apology sentence when the model was unavailable or over budget

business_slug.description: Echo of the slug that was queried

referral_url.description: Signed, tracked link to the business's own website for the user to follow; null when the business lists no website

title: Query Business Agent
